name: strat-lab
description: A backtesting workbench for this repository's xstockstrat MCP server (which must be connected — without it the skill has nothing to call): ensures data coverage (backfill), runs strategy backtests, survives the >token-limit diagnostics payload by saving-and-parsing, aggregates an independent-per-symbol basket, and verifies results against a pre-change oracle before trusting them.
